target.output: atomic recovery-claim exclusivity guard + collision reconciliation canary

problem: Concurrent stale-recovery workers can create more than one active recovery claim for the same opportunity, wasting capacity and requiring after-the-fact reconciliation.
acceptance: At most one active recovery claim can win per opportunity and recovery generation under concurrent create-if-absent attempts.
Losing recovery workers receive a deterministic collision result and re-enter allocation without starting duplicate material work.
Late claims and returns remain append-only evidence and are reconciled, never deleted or overwritten.
Race tests reproduce the observed duplicate-recovery collision class and prove exactly one winner.
No Current, Human Accepted, or Served authority is promoted.
title: Harden recovery-claim exclusivity
mission: Implement and falsify an atomic per-opportunity recovery-claim guard, or equivalent deterministic exclusive recovery lease, so concurrent stale-recovery workers cannot both begin material recovery for the same opportunity/generation. Losers must receive a durable collision disposition and immediately re-enter allocation. Preserve all original and late evidence append-only and keep global authority unchanged.

incident_repair.reason: Multiple same-opportunity recovery claims/runs were observed concurrently in the current worker wave; this proposal targets the concrete collision class rather than speculative throughput work.

regression_prevention.reason: Exclusive recovery prevents duplicate candidate mutations and reduces reconciliation ambiguity while retaining late evidence append-only.

unblock_value.reason: Leaf recovery collisions consume worker slots on prerequisites that gate local surface integration; deterministic losers can immediately re-enter allocation.

falsification.race: Launch at least five concurrent claim attempts against the same stale opportunity/generation and prove exactly one winner reaches material recovery while all losers get deterministic collision results.
falsification.late_evidence: Inject a late original RETURN and a losing recovery artifact; prove neither is deleted or overwritten and reconciliation remains append-only.
falsification.cross_opportunity_parallelism: Prove different opportunity IDs can still recover concurrently; exclusivity must not serialize unrelated recovery lanes.
falsification.authority: Prove the guard cannot promote READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.

source_freshness.note: The compiled public runtime lagged live main during discovery; live main paths were used as mutation truth.
